name: 💎 Mining Factory Tycoon ⛏️Casual Strategy
desc:
Welcome to Mining Factory Tycoon! ⛏️

Can you clear the mines and take your factory to the sky?

MINE OFFLINE! Your factory will continue to generate cash while you're away!

HOW TO PLAY:
- Dig all ores in the mine to clear it
- Defeat the BOSS ORE to move to the next mine
- Recruit and upgrade robots to help you
- Reach cave goals and refine ores by unlocking factory floors
- Rebirth and KEEP your tower for a boost

MAX CAVE: 270
MAX FLOOR: 14
MAX SUPER REBIRTH: 25
MAX DUNGEONS: 150

Premium players get more cash in-game, and invite friends for a friend boost!

Check back for new caves & content weekly!
